Hello! I'd be happy to explain our product lineup so you can understand the differences.

We offer both hardware components and various firmware/software solutions:

### Hardware Components
* Full Hardware Bundle (250 EUR): Includes the Makcu, DMA Card, and Fuser. (Express shipping is not included).
* Individual Components:
* DMA Card (115 EUR): Reads system memory independently of the CPU to send to your secondary PC.
* Fuser (105 EUR): Hardware used to overlay the radar/visuals onto your main monitor.
* Makcu (35 EUR): An auxiliary hardware component.

### Firmware Products (Traditional DMA)
* ELYRA EAC (190 EUR): Targeted firmware for EAC games (Rust, Apex, Fortnite, R6, Tarkov, CoD). Undetected since release 6 months ago. Supports cards: 35t, 75t, 100t, ZDMA.
* ELYRA VGK (230 EUR): Targeted firmware for Valorant (Vanguard). Supports the new VGK IOMMU restriction (Intel only). Supports cards: 35t, 75t, 100t, ZDMA.
* ELYRA PRIVATE (450 EUR): Premium private firmware supporting major anti-cheats (VGK, EAC, BE, FaceIT) with limited slots (10–15 slots) for high exclusivity. Supports cards: 75t, 100t, ZDMA.
* ELYRA SLOT (750 EUR): Our most exclusive physical hardware firmware, limited to 5 SLOTS ONLY. Works on Intel & AMD and supports all anti-cheats. Supports cards: 75t, 100t, ZDMA.

### Advanced Solutions (No DMA Card Required)
* EDMA by Elyra (1500 EUR + subscription): Operates at the SMM (Ring -2) BIOS/UEFI level. No physical DMA card required. Invisible to all anti-cheats. Requires an application and review process with ID verification.
* ELYRA CS2 SMM Module (1500 EUR + subscription): SMM Ring -2 architecture specifically built for CS2, including a built-in humanized aimbot and ESP features.
* ELYRA Valorant SMM Module (1200 EUR + subscription): SMM Ring -2 architecture built for Valorant, including an aimbot and ESP features.
